Appendix III. URBAN DESIGN/JOINT DEVELOPMENT/VALUE CAPTURE ANALYSIS
The following volume of the appendix is comprised of four consultant reports which were prepared during this conceptual level alternative analysis study. They do not indicate precise urban design schemes. They are intended to be illustrative of what possibilities may exist in the near future. These types of designs will be determined during later stages of project development.
